speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) is transforming our healthcare system, so it remains high quality, accessible and affordable, even as our population ages and patient load increases.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: MOH will need to expand healthcare infrastructure to meet rising demand.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: Medical workforce transformation in public hospitals will be a key priority in this term of Government.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: We will formalise Family Medicine as a specialty, given its growing importance to population health.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: We will enhance the capabilities of our nurses and allied health professionals through modular work-study training pathways, enabling them to take on more complex and varied roles in areas of need, such as in palliative care, critical care and community health.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: Acute hospitals will adopt a more holistic and patient-centred model by consolidating care across various specialist teams.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: MOH will drive technology adoption proactively and thoughtfully, with a focus on impactful systemwide use-cases.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: We will also deepen research in genomics and introduce more cost-effective precision medicine therapies into our mainstream healthcare system.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: We will better support enrollees to fulfil their health plans and expand coverage for mental health conditions.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: We will improve environmental determinants of good health, including by helping individuals cut down sodium and fat intake through better food labelling and enhancing sports and fitness facilities in the community.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: MOH will upgrade Grow Well SG to help our young build healthier habits and reduce risks from sedentary lifestyles and excessive screen time.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: We will place special focus on their mental health.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: Together with the Ministry of Home Affairs and other agencies, we will also rigorously enforce against vaping, especially etomidate-laced vapes, which can destroy many young lives.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: Under Age Well SG, MOH is helping seniors age actively within the community and stay socially connected.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: This includes plans to expand our Active Ageing Centre network and better coordinate community-based care support for seniors, from Home Personal Care to Shared Stay-in Senior Caregiving.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: Public hospitals will expand services in the community through Community Health Posts, which will, over time be synergised with the Active Ageing Centres.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: Other agencies will make the physical living environment more senior-friendly, such as through the Silver Upgrading Programme and the Friendly Streets initiative.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: Singapore lacks space for many retirement villages, but by combining and integrating these improvements, we can transform existing housing estates into Age Well Neighbourhoods, where seniors can age in place healthily.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: MOH will continue to review our S+3M system (Subsidies, MediShield Life, MediSave and MediFund) so that healthcare remains affordable.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: In particular, our schemes must help anchor care in the community by strengthening the role of the General Practitioners in enhancing population health and looking after chronic patients in the community.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
text: This is unsustainable and we will work with the industry to address this.
